PATTERN: app/page.tsx handles both auth states
- Unauthenticated: renders full LandingPage component inline (no redirect)
- Authenticated: renders main search app with Header

/login page: minimal OAuth trigger only — in dev shows Credentials 'Dev Login' button, in prod triggers Google OAuth

DASHBOARD: redirects to / instead of /login

WHY: Previous setup redirected / → /login which made /login act as landing page — confusing and wrong. Real products have a homepage at /.

DEV BYPASS: NextAuth Credentials provider only active in NODE_ENV=development. Dev user gets 9999 searches. In auth.ts, providers array typed as `Provider[]` to allow mixed types.
